Meet the Doctor

Dr. Mainak Patel, DMD

Dr. Mainak Patel grew up in Central Florida and graduated from Winter Park High School. He has enjoyed creative engineering and sciences from an early age, participating in numerous science fairs and volunteering for Habitat for Humanity. His passion for math, science, and engineering brought him to healthcare.

He earned a Bachelor of Arts and Sciences degree at the University of Florida, majoring in Microbiology and Cell Science, and continued at the University of Florida College of Dentistry, where he received his Doctor of Dental Medicine (DMD).

Dr. Patel’s mission is to understand each patient’s unique wants and needs, then build a thoughtful plan around them. In his free time, he enjoys spending time with his wife and family, traveling, and playing sports.

UFCollege of Dentistry, DMD
ICOIFellow, Intl. Congress of Oral Implantologists
AAIDAmerican Academy of Implant Dentistry
ADAAmerican & Florida Dental Associations

Also a proud member of the Academy of General Dentistry, with a focus on computer-assisted dentistry and minimally invasive guided surgeries.

Our Commitment

Thoughtful, Personalized Dental Care

The House of Dental is committed to providing thoughtful dental care to the Winter Park, FL community and beyond. Along with his team, Dr. Patel focuses on customized care — connecting with every patient to meet their specific needs.

His highly trained staff shares the belief that a team approach is at the core of a successful dental practice. From cosmetic to preventive dentistry, we offer comprehensive dental services for people of all ages.
